rules.name: Silent Sisterhood
rules.legend: The Null Maidens of the Silent Sisterhood bring with them the nightmare pall of their collective null aura, afflicting their opponents with a creeping sense of dread.
rules.html:
• When mustering your army, you can select a friendly Anathema Psykana Character model to be your WARLORD.
  • Friendly Prosecutor SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
  • Friendly Anathema Psykana units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below starting strength makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
stratagems.legend: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Prosecutor squad unit has shot.

TARGET: That PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is prosecuted until the end of the turn:
  • Attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: PURGATION SWEEP
stratagems.legend: The role of the Witchseeker on the battlefield is simple: to reduce their intended targets to ash.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Witchseeker squad unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s [Torrent] attacks have:
  • +1 A.
  • Or: If those attacks target a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +2 A.

stratagems.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
stratagems.legend: Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the blade, demonstrating a skill-at-arms as terrifying as their soulless aura.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Vigilator squad unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That VIGILATOR SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1]
  • Or: [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.legend: Knights-Centura of the Chamber of Oblivion demonstrate exceptional prowess with whichever weapons they opt to wield. Woe betide any witch who crosses their path.
enhancements.html:
Anathema Psykana model only. This unit’s attacks have:
  • +1 to hit rolls.
  • Or: If this unit targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit, +1 to hit rolls and wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.legend: This ancient bionic focuses the bearer’s null aura into a horrifying stare that can terrify foes to death.
enhancements.html: Anathema Psykana model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

rules.name: Assemblage of Might
rules.legend: The Emperor’s Custodians will gladly test their mettle against the worst the galaxy has to offer.
rules.html: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly Adeptus Custodes Character models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.legend: Even as death is certain, the Emperor’s Ten Thousand will not relent, fighting to their last breath in defence of the Golden Throne.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if that model is a Character model:
  • On a 3+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: GILDED CHAMPION
stratagems.legend: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Character model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.

EFFECT: Your model can use that (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability one additional time, but not in the same phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.legend: Long-forgotten technologies shroud this cloak’s bearer.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has:
  • Stealth
  • Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.legend: The cellular alchemy by which this heroic warrior was forged has rendered them breathtakingly resilient.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.legend: A master orator, this Custodian’s battle cries light fires of defiance in the hearts of their allies.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. (Once per battle round, per army) At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked Adeptus Custodes unit within 9" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

rules.name: Overwhelming Magnificence
rules.legend: To confront the towering, auramite-clad warriors of the Adeptus Custodes across an open battlefield is terrifying enough. To meet them in the cramped confines of a voidship is so overwhelming as to render many foes witless.
rules.html: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".

stratagems.name: BREACHING BEHEMOTHS
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: When unleashed aboard an enemy voidship, Custodians simply smash a path through any who stand against them by their sheer armoured might.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.

stratagems.name: INESCAPABLE VENGEANCE
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The incredible sensory acuity of the Custodians' wargear coupled with their superhuman senses means no foe can hide from them.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.

stratagems.name: AURIC STORM
stratagems.type: Voyagers in Darkness – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Voidstrider
enhancements.legend: At home in voidborne warfare, this superhuman warrior is able to move with marked purpose and speed.
enhancements.html: Add 2" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Mantle of the Emissary
enhancements.legend: This ancient cloak symbolises its wearer’s dedication to a vision-sent mission from the Emperor, and fills them with overwhelming purpose and determination.
enhancements.html: The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

rules.name: Priority Quarry
rules.legend: With merciless efficiency, the Sisters of Silence mark their priority prey amidst the maelstrom of shiphoard combat, then focus on their elimination above all else.
rules.html: At the start of the first battle round, you can select up to two enemy units to be your army’s quarry, one of which must be your opponents WARLORD. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army makes an attack that targets one of your army’s quarries, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army declares a charge, it can include one or more of your army’s quarries as targets of that charge, even if they are not visible to it.

stratagems.name: FOCUSED FEAR
stratagems.type: Black Ship Guardians – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Fighting in the confines of a voidship heightens the fearful aura of the Sisters of Silence, fouling their foes'aim and weakening their sword arms.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: BLADES OF THE VIGILATORS
stratagems.type: Black Ship Guardians – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Though intended for lopping the heads from witches, the Vigilators' long blades also allow for skilful parrying of incoming attacks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One VIgiLATORS, ALEYA or KNIGHT-CENTURA equipped with an executioner greatblade unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: PUNISHMENT OF THE PROSECUTORS
stratagems.type: Black Ship Guardians – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The Prosecutors cut down without mercy all who dare stand between the Silent Sisters and their prey.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PROSEcUTORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.

stratagems.name: CORNERED PREY
stratagems.type: Black Ship Guardians – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Once they have their quarry trapped within a section of the voidship, the Silent Sisters relentlessly run them to ground.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: The Vratine Aquila (Aura)
enhancements.legend: This ancient device is said to have been crafted for use during a vital conclave during the waning days of the Great Crusade, wreathing its bearer in energy veils.
enhancements.html: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. While a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is within 3" of the bearer, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Sinister Presence (Aura)
enhancements.legend: So deeply unsettling is the null aura surrounding this warrior that it causes unreasoning paranoia to spread amongst her foes, shattering their focus.
enhancements.html: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer (when measuring this distance, Walls and closed Hatchways are ignored), that unit cannot Seize objective markers and, in your opponent’s Command phase, that unit must take a Battle-shock lest. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

rules.name: On Gilded Wings
rules.legend: Terminator sodalities are swept up by golden drop craft, ready to be deployed once more as battle demands.
rules.html: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit is unengaged, you can place that unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: FURY OF THE EMPEROR
stratagems.legend: For all their physical might, it is the wrathful fury of the Adeptus Custodes that renders them truly terrifying. This is a gift they owe to the Emperor, who vested them with but a sliver of His terrible fury.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
stratagems.legend: Terminator-armoured Custodian champions fight alone and unaided, engaging entire formations in unrelenting battle.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that has 2+ models.

EFFECT: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.

stratagems.name: VIGIL UNENDING
stratagems.legend: So long as their duty remains unfulfilled, the Adeptus Custodes remain defiant in the face of their opponents.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.legend: This Shield-Captain knows well the value of intelligence, utilising data harvested by agents of the Golden Throne to strike like a bolt of golden lightning before the foe can bring their strength to bear.
enhancements.html: Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.legend: This Shield-Captain demands boundless aggression from the warriors at their command. Each movement by the foe is seized upon and punished with furious countercharges.
enhancements.html:
Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour model only. (Once per phase, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
  • That use is -1 CP.
  • That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

rules.name: Moritoi Ancients
rules.legend: The auramite giants of the Moritoi are terrifying to behold, moving with the grace of mortal warriors. Wounds serve only to increase the ferocity with which they slaughter their foes.
rules.html:
• While a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is at starting strength, that unit has +2 OC.
  • While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below starting strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half-strength, that unit’s attacks can:
    • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
    • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
stratagems.legend: Few obstacles can impede a Custodian Dreadnought in full flow. Those that do are smashed down to clear a path.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: HONOURED INTERRED
stratagems.legend: To fight in the shadow of the Moritoi is inspirational for any Custodian.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has the following ability:
Honoured Interred (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: UNCEASING ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.legend: Drawing upon the full extent of their organic and mechanical might, this Dreadnought advances with unrelenting aggression, dispensing death with archeotech weaponry and crushing fist alike.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit ends an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT:
  • Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault] until the end of the turn.
  • That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi (one per army)
enhancements.legend: This reliquary contains drops of blood, promethium and amniotic fluid harvested from the fractured form of a fallen Dreadnought. Said to be infused with the remaining fury of fallen warrior and war machine, this device inspires wrathful fury in those who bear it to war.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 A, S and D.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink (one per army)
enhancements.legend: The war engines of the Adeptus Custodes possess an array of augury equipment that combines to build an intricate picture of the unfolding conflict, enabling the bearer to detect incoming threats, then angle their armour to repel the worst of enemy attacks.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

rules.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rules.legend: Inured to the most nightmarish and esoteric threats, the Shadowkeepers will not be swayed from their duty.
rules.html:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Kaptaris
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

stratagems.name: INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS
stratagems.legend: No volume of fire or aggression will pry the Custodians from their objectives. Those who attempt to do so are subjected to the fullest extent of their violent fury.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: NO ESCAPE
stratagems.legend: Those Custodians who have served among the Shadowkeepers pursue their prey with dogged determination and will see them captured or slain.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: GRIM RESPONSIBILITY
stratagems.legend: The Shadowkeepers strive to bring the most monstrous and malevolent of the Emperor’s foes to justice, striking them down with ruthless efficiency.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster].

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.legend: This Custodian unleashes upon their opponents the Emperor’s own fury, pursuing enemy warriors with relentless determination and allowing none to flee the field.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. When this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move:
  • This unit can move up to 4".
  • You can select any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.legend: The genetic alchemy that saturates this warrior’s physiology has been tempered in wars beyond count. There are few hardships or hurts such a warrior cannot endure.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

rules.name: Martial Mastery
rules.legend: The Custodians are masters of all forms of war. There is no foe, no matter how numerous or powerful, that they cannot lay low.
rules.html:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.legend: Ever watchful and alert, these warriors switch seamlessly between martial ka’tah.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.

EFFECT: Your unit is readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
stratagems.legend: Coming to the aid of beleaguered allies, these Custodians issue challenges to their foes. Few possess the resolve to ignore these bellicose cries, and even those who refuse to respond are left shaken.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have:
  • -1 to hit rolls.
  • -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: UNLIMITED ENDURANCE
stratagems.legend: Possessed of great endurance, Custodian sodalities willl pursue their targets to the ends of the galaxy. No matter how hard they might try, none can flee from their wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
  • Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].
  • That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.legend: Every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match. The greatest among them are outstanding, even by these lofty standards.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.legend: Even the most potent of attacks struggle to penetrate the auramite plate of these warriors.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: PRIME TARGET
stratagems.legend: When a threat to the Golden Throne is identified, the Adeptus Custodes will bend every fibre of their being to ensure its destruction.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.
  • Re-roll one damage roll.

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.legend: This Captain-Commander has earned many names destroying mighty champions and powerful war machines.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Emperor's Light
enhancements.legend: This masterwork misericordia is believed to flood the hearts of its victims with searing holy radiance.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.legend: Awarded to the Custodian with the greatest tally of victories in the Blood Games, this finely worked pauldron denotes its bearer as a superlative strategic genius.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Custodes units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Eagle's Eye
enhancements.legend: The sensorium gheists within this helm shriek technomantic warnings to the wearer whenever danger threatens.
enhancements.html:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only.
  • This model has +1 W.
  • (Once per battle, per army) When attacks are allocated to this model, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 3+ InSv.

rules.name: Companion’s Watch
rules.legend: Among the Companions and the Sentinel Guard, vigilance is the most crucial of attributes.
rules.html: While a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
stratagems.legend: The loss of a single Custodian is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by Character models) have +2 A.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR'S DOMAIN
stratagems.legend: There are those territories that must remain in the hands of the Imperium and be free of foes, regardless of the cost.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Trusted Sentinel unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.legend: Every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match. The greatest among them are outstanding, even by these lofty standards.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.legend: Built into this Custodian’s armour, this aviform artefact is a relic of the Dark Age of Technology. It projects electromagnetic distortion to corrupt and confound homing beacons, teleportation technology and other methods of translocation.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries
enhancements.legend: Even while standing statue-still upon their endless watch, these Custodians are ready to spring instantly into violent action.
enhancements.html:
Trusted Sentinel unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
  • That use is -1 CP.
  • That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

rules.name: Talon Sortie
rules.legend: The Solar Watch utilise speed, mobility and the adaptable Calistus Ka’tah to confound and eviscerate opposing armies.
rules.html:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

Favoured ka’tah: Calistus
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: AT SPEAR'S LENGTH
stratagems.legend: Duty to the Golden Throne overrides all else. When called to strike a new target, Custodian sodalities withdraw from the fight in close order, keeping their spears leveled towards their foes and holding them at bay with close-range volleys of bolter fire.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE
stratagems.legend: Carried by many Custodians, these explosive devices detonate on impact, creating a field of gravitic energy that immobilises those caught in the blast radius.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE
stratagems.legend: No obstacle, physical or otherwise, can halt the advance of the Solar Watch, nor stay their wrath.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • M.
  • Advance rolls and charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.legend: This warlord excels in directing fast and deadly offensives designed to close rapidly with the enemy, overwhelming the foe with a devastating concentration of force.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Shield-Captain model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit within 6" of this model. If that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle
enhancements.legend: Embodying the raptors of ancient Terra, this champion of the Golden Throne descends upon their prey swiftly, with talons unsheathed.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Infantry/Mounted unit only (excluding Terminator units). This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

rules.name: Magna Imperator
rules.legend: The Adeptus Custodes are blessed with gifts the Emperor has given them – physical might, mental robustness and the most powerful arms and armour available.
rules.html:
When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

Favoured ka’tah: Rendax
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:
  • On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  • On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: IMPENETRABLE BASTION
stratagems.legend: When holding ground, a sodality of Custodians becomes a living fortress whose gilded walls are nigh impossible to breach.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.legend: Even the most potent of attacks struggle to penetrate the auramite plate of these warriors.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Custodian Wardens units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.legend: Ever watchful and alert, these warriors switch seamlessly between martial ka’tah.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that is not readied.

EFFECT: Your unit is readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.legend: The armouries of the Adeptus Custodes contain some of the most finely crafted and deadly close-quarters weaponry wielded by any warrior of the Imperium.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds].

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.legend: The golden glory of the Emperor Himself glows around this magnificent warrior like Sol’s own fire. Enemies are blinded by its light, forced to recoil in pain and terror.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Heralds of the Throne
rules.legend: The Emissaries Imperatus prioritise the mission over individual actions. Their favoured ka’tah, Conservai, similarly emphasises strategy.
rules.html:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units have Fights First.

Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai
Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: BEARERS OF HIS LIGHT
stratagems.legend: No matter how far they stray from the Golden Throne, all Custodians carry with them the Emperor’s light, drawing upon His guidance in the midst of battle.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF NIGHTMARES
stratagems.legend: In an age plagued by monstrous foes, primordial horrors from the darkest void circle Humanity’s dying light. These hideous aberrations the Adeptus Custodes engage without hesitation.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s T have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SELFLESS SERVICE
stratagems.legend: Any of the Ten Thousand would place themselves in peril to protect a fellow Custodian without a moment’s hesitation.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Custodes unit within 6" of an enemy unit. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit:
  • When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
  • When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

enhancements.name: Edge of the Blade
enhancements.legend: This auric champion always strives to be first into the fray.
enhancements.html:
Adeptus Custodes model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Auriferous Orb
enhancements.legend: When this sphere of solid gold detonates, it unleashes beams of radiating light that blind those they do not kill.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

rules.name: Gilded Guardians
rules.legend: Resilient experts of ranged warfare, the Aquilan Shield give no ground and punish advancing enemies with their mastery of the Salvus Ka’tah.
rules.html:
While a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Salvus
Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

stratagems.name: RAPID REACTIONS
stratagems.legend: Forcing their outmatched enemies to fall back, Custodians level their guardian spears and cut down fleeing opponents with volleys of bolter fire.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Custodes Infantry unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Adeptus Custodes never take the pressure off their foes, maintaining punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.name: TIP OF THE TALON
stratagems.legend: Fighting at the forefront of the battle, these Custodians hit their victims with perfectly timed volleys the instant before they tear into their ranks.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of your unit have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Not a Shell Wasted
enhancements.legend: Every volley these warriors fire is calculated to inflict the maximum amount of damage upon the foe.
enhancements.html: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Pareldor's Caducatrix
enhancements.legend: This immeasurably ancient auto-medicae device meshes seamlessly with any suit of armour, dispensing panacaeic elixirs in response to mental or physical trauma.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds.

rules.name: Flare Shields
rules.legend: Many Adeptus Custodes vehicles are fitted with flare shields: relics of the Dark Age of Technology that can deflect incoming fire.
rules.html: Friendly grav-assault units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: ADVANCED STABILISERS
stratagems.legend: Adeptus Custodes grav-vehicles possess highly efficient weapon stabilisation systems, enabling them to fire accurately even when travelling at maximum speed.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].

stratagems.name: VICTORY BEFORE DEATH
stratagems.legend: Scrambling from the burning wreckage of their vehicles, Custodian crews use the last of their strength to claim their assigned objectives before succumbing to their wounds.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit within range of an objective is destroyed.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.

EFFECT: Select one objective that:
  • Your unit was controlling when it was destroyed.
  • Has no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) within range of it.
That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: INEVITABLE ANNIHILATION
stratagems.legend: The preternatural dexterity and reaction times of Custodian pilots and gunners, paired with the superlative targeting augury and terrifying speed of Adeptus Custodes grav-tanks, conspire to ensure that prey have little hope of escaping their fiery doom.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly grav-assault unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Anti-gravitic Mobility
enhancements.legend: The grav-tanks of the Adeptus Custodes are exceptionally mobile, enabling their skilled crews to fade in and out of contact with the foe whilst keeping up a constant stream of killing fire.
enhancements.html: grav-assault unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.legend: Custodian vehicle crews are as consummately skilled as their infantry counterparts, delivering sodalities into the thick of the fight and suppressing foes with turret-mounted weapons to prevent incoming fire.
enhancements.html:
grav-assault Transport model only. When a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a disembark move from this unit, until the end of the turn:
  • That unit can re-roll charge rolls.
  • Enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

rules.name: Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
rules.legend: Favouring the aggressive Dacatarai fighting style, the Custodians of the Dread Host seek to outmatch their enemies in bloody melee combat.
rules.html:
Friendly Adeptus Custodes units can re-roll charge rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: Dacatarai
Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.

stratagems.name: GOLDEN LIGHT OF THE MOIRAIDES
stratagems.legend: The Dread Host goes to battle aboard the trio of terrifying pre-Heresy warships known as the Moiraides. These potent vessels teleport their passengers straight into battle amidst an eruption of dazzling golden light.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make an ingress move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES Unit.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next turn:
  • Attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
  • Enemy units cannot target your unit with snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: PRETERNATURAL RAPIDITY
stratagems.legend: The warriors of the Adeptus Custodes are relentless in their pursuit of the Throneworld’s foes.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit ends an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: LIGHTNING WRATH
stratagems.legend: Rushing forward with terrifying speed, Custodian sodalities leave their foes no opportunity to escape.
stratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit is selected to make a pile-in move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: When making that pile-in move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Flawless Bladework
enhancements.legend: This Custodian’s skills in close-quarters combat are awe-inspiring to behold.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Auric Exemplar
enhancements.legend: This champion’s physical might is exceptional, even for a Custodian. Each swing of their blade carves a bloody swathe through the foe.
enhancements.html: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Cleave 1].

coreStratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
coreStratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.

TARGET: That unit or model from your army.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.

coreStratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
coreStratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.

coreStratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
coreStratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.

TARGET: One CHARACTER model in your unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.

coreStratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
coreStratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.

TARGET: That unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

coreStratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
coreStratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit fights next.

coreStratagems.name: TANK SHOCK
coreStratagems.legend: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

coreStratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
coreStratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.

coreStratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
coreStratagems.legend: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.

EFFECT: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

coreStratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
coreStratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

TARGET: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

coreStratagems.name: GRENADE
coreStratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

coreStratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
coreStratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

coreStratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
coreStratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

coreStratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
coreStratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:
  • Advance roll
  • Charge roll
  • Damage roll
  • Hazard roll
  • Hit roll
  • Save roll
  • Wound roll
  • A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.

TARGET: That unit or model.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

coreStratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
coreStratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

coreStratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
coreStratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

coreStratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
coreStratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

coreStratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
coreStratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy’s onslaught head-on.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes:

  • Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
+1CP
  • Into the Fray:
    • When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
    • When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

coreStratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
coreStratagems.legend: Priming grenades or other explosives, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy’s midst.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit.
  2. Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model.
  3. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

coreStratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
coreStratagems.legend: In extremis, armoured vehicles and rampaging monsters can use their sheer size as a weapon, ramming and crushing enemies beneath their colossal bulk, though doing so risks sustaining damage in return.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit.
  2. Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit.
  3. Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

coreStratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
coreStratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors’ onset.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).

EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

coreStratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
coreStratagems.legend: A hail of fire can drive back advancing foes.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units).

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

coreStratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
coreStratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.

EFFECT: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

coreStratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
coreStratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.
coreStratagems.html:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.

EFFECT: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

factionRules.name: Martial Ka’tah
factionRules.legend: The Adeptus Custodes have developed many thousands of martial ka’tahs. Custodians are proficient in many of these arts, shifting stances according to the battlefield situation.
factionRules.html:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka’tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.

Each ka’tah ability will tell you when that ka’tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka’tah ability has on the unit using it.

We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied.

Favoured Ka’tah

Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka’tah above all others.

All detachments tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka’tah ability that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.

Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka’tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

CALISTUS

Its path cleared, the Knight Castigator then strides forward to carve apart light vehicles or monstrous chitinous beasts with its tempest warblade.

questorisknightmagaera.name: Questoris Knight Magaera
questorisknightmagaera.legend: The Knight Magaera is a marvel of lost technology, ranging from its repair auto-simulacra to its nigh impregnable ionic flare shield. These esoteric devices make the Magaera ideally suited to shock assaults and breaching actions, enabling the Knight to surge through the most heavily defended positions unscathed and eradicate its foes with terrifying blasts from its lightning cannon.

DAMAGED24.39
This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

000008339.name: Deadly Demise
000008339.html:
DEADLY DEMISE24.08

From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.

This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

000008391.name: Martial Ka’tah
000008391.html:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka’tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.

Each ka’tah ability will tell you when that ka’tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka’tah ability has on the unit using it.

We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied.

Favoured Ka’tah

Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka’tah above all others.

All detachments tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka’tah ability that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.

Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka’tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

CONSERVAI
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
  • Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
  • Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
CALISTUS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.
SALVUS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.
DACATARAI
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
KAPTARIS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
RENDAX
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

000008343.name: Deep Strike
000008343.html:
DEEP STRIKE24.09

There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.

Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

000008338.name: Feel No Pain
000008338.html:
FEEL NO PAIN24.12

The hardiest warriors refuse to be laid low, even by wounds that should by all rights prove lethal.

This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

000008346.name: Leader
000008346.html:
LEADER24.22

Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.

Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

000011233.name: Aquila Commander
000011233.html: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

000008342.name: Hover
000008342.html:
HOVER24.17

Some airborne vehicles can use vectored thrusters or anti-gravity technology to hover and skim over the battlefield, the better to hunt their prey or deploy embarked troops.

Each time this unit takes to the skies (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the maximum distance.

000008344.name: Scouts
000008344.html:
SCOUTS24.31

Scouts form the vanguard of many armies. Unnoticed by the enemy, they range ahead of the main force.

This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
  • If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
  • If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
  • If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE24.32
MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".
ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.
EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).
AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

000011230.name: Daughters of the Abyss
000011230.html:
• Friendly Anathema Psykana units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
  • Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

000010857.name: Support
000010857.html:
SUPPORT24.34

Specialist combatants may be assigned to front-line squads to bolster their fighting effectiveness.

Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

000008334.name: Firing Deck
000008334.html:
FIRING DECK24.14

Some transports have dedicated platforms or firing ports from which embarked passengers can lay down a withering hail of munitions.

This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence:
  1. Select up to X models embarked within this TRANSPORT (excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase).
  2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons).
  3. Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons.
  4. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

000008345.name: Infiltrators
000008345.html:
INFILTRATORS24.20

Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.

During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

000008336.name: Lone Operative
000008336.html:
LONE OPERATIVE24.24

Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle.

Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit.

If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

000008337.name: Stealth
000008337.html:
STEALTH24.33

The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes.

If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

000008452.name: Assigned Agents
000008452.html:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

Incursion111
Strike Force221

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

000008340.name: Fights First
000008340.html:
FIGHTS FIRST24.13

Those possessed of lightning-fast reactions may strike before the opponent can react.

While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a Fights First unit.

See the Resolve Fights First Combats step in the Fight phase (12.04).

000008519.name: Kill Team
000008519.html:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

000008458.name: Code Chivalric
000008458.html:
If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army’s Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part, shown below.

To determine your army’s Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army’s Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

 Deed
D6

We vow to lay low the tyrant...

At the start of the battle, select one CHARACTER model in your opponent’s army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed.		  

We swear to reclaim the realm...

This deed is completed at the end of your opponent’s turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.		  

We pledge to reap a great tally...

This deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield (for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).		  
 Quality
D6

...with our martial valour risen over all.

Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.		  

...and we are eager for the challenge.

Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.		  

...yet shall our legacy be unsullied.

Improve this model’s Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

000008460.name: Super-heavy Walker
000008460.html:
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
  • It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
  • It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

000008538.name: Super-heavy Walker
000008538.html: Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move over models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.
